title: Power Book IV: Force's Joseph Sikora Unleashed His Opinion On Which Member Of Power Universe Needs A Spin Off Series
htmlContent:
Joseph Sikora recently revealed what character from the Power universe should have its own spin-off.

50 Cent plans to produce some more BMF spinoffs after the Power universe's success. Shortly afterward, Fif and Courtney Kemp launched three spinoffs: Power II: Ghost, Power III: Raising Kanan, and Power IV: Force. This one follows the story of Tommy Egan, interpreted by Joseph Sikora, who is from New York to settle in Chicago.

During the red carpet of Fear, starring Sikora, T.I., and Annie IIonzeh, we asked the Power star who, in his opinion, deserved a spin-off. He did not hesitate to hand her flowers to Kris D Lofton during the interview. Lofton, which has delivered incredible performance strength, stars like Jerard Sampson.
Sikora said that he would like to see a Sampson-based spin-off in an interview with Baller Alert.

Power IV: Force made its debut in February 2022 after the success of Raising Kanan and Ghost, instantly becoming a preferred spin-off in the Power franchise. With Sikora and Lofton, it also features Isaac Keys, Lucien Cambric, Anthony Fleming III, Gabriel Ryan, and many others. In addition, Jeremih and Freddie Gibbs also picked up roles in the series.

Speaking of Sikora, he recently shared when we might see Forces make it's second season debut.

Sikora was on Instagram Live and said that Starz had not announced the actual date, but  he had it on good authority that it could drop in May of 2023.
